Protocol Rebirth — Abandoned Town Dressing Kit v0.2

20 incremental low-poly GLB assets. Add these alongside v0.1 under assets/env/town/. 1 unit = 1 meter; Y is up; each origin is centered on the footprint at ground level. Shared named PBR palette; no external textures required.

Use manifest.json for approximate bounds, category and placement hints. Collision is intentionally not baked in; create simple colliders in the game engine.
